ExUnit.start()
Code.require_file("qa/partition-merge.exs")
defmodule PartitionProvenanceReviewTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "aggregation rejects a matching partition from a different runner invocation" do
    root = "/private/tmp/bylaw-partitions-20260906"
    old = root <> "/reviewer-provenance-first"
    current = root <> "/reviewer-provenance"
    archived_path = old <> "/1-sequential2/plan.json"
    original_plan = archived_path |> File.read!() |> JSON.decode!()
    relocated = Map.update!(original_plan, "partitions", fn rows ->
      Enum.map(rows, fn row ->
        row
        |> Map.update!("capture", &String.replace_prefix(&1, current, old))
        |> Map.update!("audit", &String.replace_prefix(&1, current, old))
      end)
    end)
    relocated_path = root <> "/reviewer/archived-input-plan.json"
    File.write!(relocated_path, JSON.encode!(relocated))
    {plan, [old_first, old_second]} = BylawPartitionMerge.load_plan(relocated_path)
    {new_plan, [new_first, new_second]} = BylawPartitionMerge.load_plan(current <> "/1-sequential2/plan.json")
    assert {:ok, _} = BylawPartitionMerge.merge(plan, [old_first, old_second])
    assert {:ok, _} = BylawPartitionMerge.merge(new_plan, [new_first, new_second])
    assert old_first.monotonic_boundaries_us.init_started != new_first.monotonic_boundaries_us.init_started
    assert {:error, %{reason: :incompatible_partition}} =
      BylawPartitionMerge.merge(plan, [old_first, new_second])
  end
end
